facts: composite DTM covers about 99 percent of England
DTM removes surface objects from DSM using algorithms and manual editing
composite combines Time Stamped archive and National LIDAR Programme surveys
newest best-resolution data is used where repeat surveys exist
resampled source data uses bilinear interpolation before merge
metadata index catalogues identify which survey was used at a location
vertical accuracy is plus or minus 15cm RMSE
WCS is available for raster access
WMS and metadata index services are also available
2m DTM follows the same composite lineage principles
10m DTM is resampled from the 2m composite using bilinear interpolation
DSM includes surface objects and must not be substituted for terrain
persistent service URLs provide current composite service endpoints

promotion_rule: Runtime sampling must use DTM terrain semantics and retain location-specific source lineage; coarse/resampled derivatives cannot silently replace the 1m primary source.
